api_endpoints.POST /screening/start: Initialize a new screening call session for a candidate
api_endpoints.POST /screening/{id}/question: Deliver the next question and move the state machine forward
api_endpoints.POST /screening/{id}/answer: Submit a candidate answer for processing and classification
api_endpoints.GET /screening/{id}/status: Return the current state, turn count, and failure count for a session
api_endpoints.POST /screening/{id}/end: End the call and trigger final report generation
api_endpoints.GET /screening/{id}/report: Retrieve the generated screening report in JSON, Markdown, or text
